concerns.text: FR-004 mandates hyperparameter grid search constrained to 'depth ≤ 6'. Tasks T018 and T019 explicitly constrain the grid search to 'depth ≤ 10'. This is a semantic weakening of the spec's performance and complexity constraints, violating FR-004.

FR-004 requires training Random Forest with '100-200 trees' and Gradient Boosting with '50-100 trees'. Tasks T018 and T019 constrain the grid search to 'trees ≤ 50'. This caps the model capacity below the spec's minimum requirement, violating FR-004.

FR-009 mandates VIF computation 'within the full multiple regression model' to filter descriptors for significance testing. Task T023 calculates VIF for 'ALL trained models' including Random Forest and Gradient Boosting. Tree-based models do not use VIF for collinearity diagnostics in the same linear regression context; applying VIF here is a methodological drift that dilutes the specific requirement of FR-009.

FR-001 requires the system to 'flag a data limitation' if count < 500. Task T015 writes this flag to a JSON file (`output/data_status.json`) but lacks an explicit instruction to surface this flag to the user (stdout/stderr) or integrate it into the final report as a visible warning, risking the 'flagging' action being silently ignored.

SC-007 requires a 'validation log or report confirming successful execution' of quickstart. Task T036 ('Run quickstart.md validation') is marked as incomplete `[ ]` and has no corresponding implementation task to generate the `quickstart_validation_report.json` referenced in the plan. This leaves SC-007 unimplemented.
